purpose: Independent held-out single-round comparison of two owner-specified fixed models; no training and no champion promotion

rules.unit: one complete round to finishing order
rules.tributeReason: Fresh independent deals, no preceding round; not a tribute or full-match evaluation

pairing: Exactly the same 108 card IDs at the same seats, level and first leader; swap model/team allocation between parity 0 and 1. Mixed focal seat alternates between teammates by seed parity. Both games must complete to count a pair.
pipeline: Native ONNX CPU one thread; raw neural argmax over canonical candidates, no web personality/endgame/finishing shortcut, no Clint heuristics added to neural policies. Clint independent rules-v2 own-hand/public-only.

analysis.primary: Mean signed round upgrade points of latest vs champion, averaged within each seed pair; 95% paired-cluster normal CI, 1.96*sampleSD/sqrt(n). Positive supports latest, negative champion, crossing zero inconclusive.
analysis.secondary: Both models vs Clint/P0/previous and with Clint teammate vs two Clint. Same seed across candidates; analyze latest-minus-champion paired-cluster signed-point difference. Four secondary contrasts with Bonferroni 98.75% CIs (z=2.4977054744). Do not pool opponents into one win rate.
analysis.alsoReport: Actual W/L/D, mean signed points, finishing-rank pairs, double-wins/losses, mean turns; seed-cluster uncertainty. No optional stopping by outcome or sample expansion.
analysis.decision: Report primary and heterogeneous secondary effects separately; no forced overall winner when uncertainty or matchup reversal remains. No automatic webpage champion replacement.
